name: story.bank
description: Score one answer-bank story for reuse: completeness, ownership, number, and which competency it proves. Rank stories to pick the lead story for a given JD (pass the JD as context).

star_complete.instructions: Situation, own action, result all present
criteria: All present with a mechanism explained

personal_action.instructions: The action is clearly the candidate's own decision, not the team's

number_present.instructions: The result carries a specific number with scope

fits_jd.instructions: Given the JD provided in context, this story is one of the two best to lead with

rules.reason: rewrite in first person with the decision named

notes: Created 2026-09-18 for Project Get a Job. Advisory until labelled.
